sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 31 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：RDDT、GOOGL、AMZN、MU、SNDK。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Extreme earnings-day divergence defined the entire market: AMZN +14.65% (270.29) and MSFT +2.28% (461.82) were heavily rewarded by the market for their ability to monetize AI; AAPL plunged -9.47% (301.52, intraday low 300.33) on weak Q4 guidance and pressure on its China business, with one stock nearly offsetting AMZN's entire contribution. As a result, the indices barely moved—SPY is currently at 743.54 (+0.26%) and QQQ at 685.32 (+0.25%), though both traced out complete inverted-V moves followed by recoveries this morning: SPY 746.30→737.70 and QQQ 695.67→680.21.
  • GOOGL fully recovered its post-earnings decline: +5.65% to 352.49 (intraday high 353.60), driven by its cloud business turning profitable, DeepMind's launch of the Gemini Robotics 2 series of robotics models, and a strategic shift toward selling its proprietary TPU systems directly to customer data centers for the first time.
  • RDDT collapsed -22.76% to 137.60 after beating expectations across the board (low 135.33): revenue of $805 million vs. $730 million expected and EPS of 1.25 vs. 0.95, but the phrase "search referrals were choppy" in the shareholder letter confirmed concerns about dependence on Google search traffic. Combined with stagnant U.S. DAU growth, this prompted multiple investment banks to downgrade the stock.
  • RBLX -28.50% to 34.78: Q2 user engagement, bookings, and hours all fell short of expectations, while Q3 guidance was even weaker. Management attributed the weakness to declining monetization among younger users in the U.S. and Canada. Deutsche Bank downgraded the stock to Hold and cut its price target from 56→38. COIN -13.00% and MSTR -5.33% also collapsed.
  • Geopolitics and interest rates are the genuinely underestimated sources of pressure: The IRGC said it struck two U.S.-military-escorted tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, while four other vessels turned back; the 30Y U.S. Treasury yield reached 5.244%, its highest level since 2007, and the 10Y approached 4.73%. TLT fell -0.83% to 82.11, nearing an all-time low. The yen was suspected of being supported by official intervention, with community rumors claiming that the U.S. Treasury was also involved.
  • The memory sector extended its inverted-V pattern: MU fell from an opening price of 918.83 to 830.26 (-5.09%, low 818), while SNDK opened at 1383, reached 1405, and then retreated to 1224 (-4.37%, low 1189)—but WDC +3.02% and SOXL +2.30%, indicating that the selling remained concentrated in memory rather than the entire semiconductor sector.

社区氛围：一种极度疲惫、愤怒、混乱的状态——市场单向方向感完全消失，社区将连续两天的双向假涨解读为做市商故意爆仓。 “操纵/操纵”是全天最常见的指控。与此同时，GOOGL 的多头们正在公开庆祝，制造了一种“指数麻木、个股狂热”的分裂情绪。

恐惧/贪婪程度：普遍恐惧，但并不极端，估计为 30-35（恐惧区域）。恐惧集中在三个方面：内存、RDDT 和加密货币。与此同时，AMZN/GOOGL 的追势行为以及“逢低买入 RDDT”的呼声表明贪婪尚未消失。真正的恐惧并不在于指数，而在于“无论做什么我都会输”的路径依赖信念的崩溃——许多评论描述了用户购买看涨期权后股票立即下跌，购买看跌期权后股票立即上涨。

情绪与实际价格走势：社区感觉市场正在经历一场“大屠杀”，但指数目前仅略高。一条获得高度评价的评论准确地捕捉到了这种差异：指数平均值掩盖了个股 ±10% 的剧烈波动。 IWM -0.79% 和大幅表现不佳表明市场广度确实在恶化，因此社区的悲观情绪并非完全没有根据——它只是在指数层面被误用了。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及看涨/看跌情绪核心观点总结
MU60+看跌从开盘价926跌至818，社区称其为“两天300点往返”； 850为阻力位，跌破800为心理投降线；许多追赶周四大涨的投资者都被困住了，“一盈亏平衡我就离开——即使后来涨到2000点”是常有的说法；空头在785P/800P上获利颇丰；有些人仍然说600点是真正的入场点，而另一些人则全押在V形反转上
RDDT55+中立（极度分裂）每股收益增长超过 30%，收入增长 61%，指引超出预期，但股价却暴跌 23%，令业界无法接受这一举动；悲观案例的核心是美国 DAU 停滞+谷歌摘要拦截流量+没有新的人工智能许可协议；看多者押注 ARPU 仅为 47 美元，而 Meta 为 220 美元、Google 续订或 Anthropic 和解；逢低买入水平为142/135/130/120，而一些人则呼吁回归IPO价格； CSP卖家和LEAPS买家都出现了
